description: Persist a high-salience (0.9) Semantic handoff memory into a target specialist wing namespace (wing:<target>) (consumes 1 Write API call; non-idempotent: repeated calls create distinct handoff records) and return { id, wing, namespace }. Accepts target wing via wing or alias to_wing (defaults to "architect") and sender via from_agent or alias from_wing (defaults to "agent"), attaching files and memory_ids as searchable context tuples. Use when delegating findings and next steps between architect, reviewer, qa, security, or ops agents; use encode_memory instead for general project memories.

files.description: Optional file paths attached as ["file", path] context tags.

from_agent.description: Identifier of the sending agent or role (preferred; defaults to "agent").

from_wing.description: Alias for sending specialist wing used when from_agent is omitted.

memory_ids.description: Optional related memory UUIDs attached as ["memory_id", id] context tags.

summary.description: Required concise summary of architectural findings, constraints, and state.

task.description: Optional concrete follow-up action appended for the receiving wing.

to_wing.description: Alias for destination wing used when wing is omitted.

wing.description: Destination specialist wing (preferred; defaults to "architect" if both wing and to_wing are omitted).

name: handoff_to_agent
title: Hand Off Context to Specialist Wing
